{{About|censuses since 1948 of the former Yugoslav and present independent [[North Macedonia]]|a more detailed overview of current demographics from the 2002 census|Demographics of North Macedonia| the demographic history before World War II of the [[Macedonia (region)|historical Macedonian region]] that crossed several present-day Balkan borders|Demographic history of Macedonia}}

{{History of North Macedonia}}
This article presents the '''demographic history of North Macedonia''' through census results since 1948.

==1948 census==

*'''TOTAL = 1,152,986'''
*[[Macedonians (ethnic group)|Macedonians]] = 789,603 (''68.5%'')
*[[Albanians in North Macedonia|Albanians]] = 197,603 (''17.1%'')
*[[Turks in North Macedonia|Turks]] = 95,940 (''8.3%'')
*[[Serbs in North Macedonia|Serbs]] = 29,721 (''2.6%'')
*[[Romani people in North Macedonia|Romani]] = 19,500 (''1.7%'')
*[[Aromanians in North Macedonia|Aromanians]] = 9,511 (''0.8%'')
*[[Montenegrins of North Macedonia|Montenegrins]] = 2,348 (''0.2%'')
*[[Croats in North Macedonia|Croats]] = 2,090
*[[Muslims (ethnic group)|Muslims]] = 1,560
*Others = 5,324 (''0.46%'')
